greeting.text: Welcome. What seems to be bothering you?

lines.text: How often do you get headaches?
Take this after meals, no more than three times a day.
Drink lots of water, and don't stare at screens too long.

flushRemark.text: You seem a little feverish. Shall we check your temperature?

closers.endured: If it keeps hurting, please see a doctor.
closers.sos: Sure, go ahead with your call~
